mapper.select: select urm.id from t_user_role_map urm inner join t_role r on r.role_id = urm.role_id where urm.user_id = #{userId} and upper(r.name) = 'EXPERT' limit 1 for update

select urm.id from t_user_role_map urm inner join t_role r on r.role_id = urm.role_id inner join t_user u on u.user_id = urm.user_id where urm.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(u.status, 0) = 0 and upper(r.name) in ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') order by urm.id limit 1 for update
